Tapasya Tapasya aims to address the lack of opportunity for holistic development of families from economically and socially disadvantaged backgrounds by providing an ecosystem of support and care, and increasing awareness of welfare schemes. Geographies Served Programs Project Sakhi District Satara Pune State Maharashtra District Satara Pune States Maharashtra Our main focus is on the Leadership Development of community people around unlocking access to multiple social welfare schemes, who will be supported on - Community-level Awareness of various welfare schemes and their benefits and process. - Identification of eligible families who can apply for any eligible schemes. - Document readiness: Helping families ensure all required documents are ready. - Application support: Supporting families to apply for all the eligible schemes by filling the application either online or offline and get their final benefits. Together, we have facilitated benefits with a cumulative value exceeding ₹500 crore. Additionally, we are running seven Tapasya Seva Kendras across different communities to extend our reach and impact. Vision and Mission Tapasya's vision is to empower vulnerable families to access government benefits and facilitate their path out of poverty within their lifetime, while their mission is to empower one million vulnerable families with knowledge and tools to harness the power of social welfare programs by 2030.
